parts.t: Discover easy living in Aldergrove Town Centre! This bright 1-bedroom home blends modern style with everyday comfort. The open layout features a sleek kitchen, spacious living area, and large windows that fill the space with natural light. Perfectly located near shops, restaurants, and Shortreed Elementary. Enjoy 1 secure parking stall and 1 storage locker for added convenience. A great opportunity to own in a growing community!
